name: GET /api/leadflow/dashboards/leadership - the leadership view
description:
Pipeline health, onboarding attainment, source performance and open escalations.

ONE DASHBOARD PER ROLE, not one dashboard with a filter. A rep looking at leadership's revenue view and a leader looking at a rep's task list are both looking at the wrong screen, and a shared screen means one of them always is. QA: measured live.

testCases.name: NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
